department: Electrical & Computer Engineering, FAMU-FSU College of Engineering

deadline.value: The page highly encourages international applicants to apply by January 15, without a year.
deadline.quote: International applicants living outside of the United States are highly encouraged to apply by January 15 for the fall semester

supervisor.value: The page does not say whether a faculty supervisor must agree before admission.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

funding.value: The college's PhD programs offer competitive funding packages to newly admitted students.
funding.quote: The FAMU-FSU College of Engineering Ph.D. programs offer competitive funding packages for newly admitted students

entry_route.value: The PhD accepts an undergraduate or a graduate GPA of 3.0 or higher.
entry_route.quote: A grade point average (GPA) of at least 3.0 on a 4.0 scale for all work attempted beyond 60 semester hours of undergraduate study or graduate GPA of 3.0 (on a 4.0 scale) or higher

notes: Joint FAMU-FSU college: apply through either university. PhD GRE minimum is 151 quantitative and 145 verbal, or a GRE waiver request. English test required if the applicant's country's official language is not English or the applicant did not graduate from an accredited US institution (school rule; India is not named). Supervisor not stated.
